messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "relaxes muscles in the airways"
set: ["relaxes muscles in the airways", "improving glucose uptake by muscles", "relaxing the muscle in the prostate and bladder neck", "reducing the production of uric acid in the body", "stimulates insulin production in the pancreas", "reduces sugar production in the liver", "reducing nerve signals in the brain", "increasing serotonin activity in the brain", "blocking the acid pump in your stomach", "restoring balance of serotonin in the brain", "changing levels of certain chemicals in the brain", "blocking alpha-1 receptors in the prostate and bladder neck", "affects chemicals in the brain that may be unbalanced in people with depression", "quieting activity in certain deeper regions of the brain", "calming overactive nerve signals in the brain and nervous system", "calming overactive electrical signals in the brain and nervous system"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
